## 2. Professional Biography & Background

Salman Ahmad is an experienced full-stack software engineer and visual designer based in Lahore, Pakistan. Operating globally under the pseudonym **ahmmikun**, he specializes in building high-throughput web applications, automation bots, interactive 3D WebGL interfaces, and scalable RESTful API microservices.

Salman holds an educational background in Computer Science and Software Engineering from Superior University. He has built a reputation in developer communities for engineering the **XLICON** multi-device WhatsApp bot platform, creating custom REST microservices for scraping and automation, and designing sleek cyberpunk-themed web interfaces utilizing Next.js, Three.js, and Tailwind CSS.

## 3. Comprehensive Technical Skill Matrix

### Programming Languages
- **JavaScript (ES6+)**: Asynchronous event handling, Promises, async/await, DOM manipulation, functional paradigms.
- **TypeScript**: Static typing, interfaces, custom types, generic functions, strict compilation.
- **Python**: Scripting, bot framework integration, web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Requests), AI prompt pipelining.
- **C / C++**: Low-level systems programming, pointers, memory allocation, algorithms and data structures.
- **Assembly (x86)**: Basic instruction sets, register operations, processor architecture understanding.
- **HTML5 / Semantic Web**: Microdata, ARIA accessibility, schema annotations, responsive structure.
- **CSS3 / PostCSS**: Flexbox, CSS Grid, custom properties, animations, media queries.

### Frontend Frameworks & Libraries
- **Next.js 16 (App Router)**: React Server Components (RSC), SSR, SSG, edge middleware, dynamic route handlers, content negotiation.
- **React 19**: Hooks, context API, state management, concurrent rendering features.
- **Tailwind CSS 4**: Theme tokens, utility classes, dynamic dark mode theming, responsive breakpoints.
- **Three.js & React Three Fiber**: WebGL rendering, 3D geometry, custom lighting, particle systems, interactive viewports.
- **Framer Motion**: Smooth entry animations, layout transitions, gesture physics.
- **Lucide Icons & React Icons**: Vector iconography and accessible UI glyphs.

### Backend, Microservices & Protocols
- **Node.js & Express**: High-performance HTTP servers, routing, middleware stacks, JSON-RPC.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Streamable HTTP and SSE transports for AI agent integration.
- **RESTful API Architecture & OpenAPI 3.1.0**: Standardized status codes, error models, and request validations.
- **Baileys Library**: Multi-device WhatsApp socket protocol handling and automated event dispatching.
- **Nodemailer**: SMTP email transport and transmission protocols.

### Databases & Cloud Infrastructure
- **MongoDB & Mongoose**: Document modeling, schema validation, aggregation pipelines, Atlas hosting.
- **MySQL**: Relational table design, foreign keys, SQL querying.
- **Hosting Platforms**: Vercel (Edge serverless functions), Cloudflare (DNS & caching), Railway, Heroku.
- **DevOps & Version Control**: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, semantic versioning.

## 4. Featured Software Projects

### Project 1: XLICON V4 MD
- **Category**: Automation / WhatsApp Bot Framework
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ahmmikun/XLICON-V4-MD
- **Stack**: Node.js, Baileys Library, MongoDB, JavaScript
- **Details**: XLICON V4 MD is a multi-device WhatsApp automation suite. It provides automated group management, dynamic commands for media conversion, image search, utility tools, spam protection, and database state management with MongoDB. It has been deployed and utilized by thousands of users across global developer communities.

### Project 2: AHMMI's REST API Service
- **Category**: Backend Microservice / REST API
- **Live Endpoint**: https://api.ahmmikun.live/
- **Stack**: Node.js, Express, REST Architecture, Cloudflare
- **Details**: A multi-functional RESTful API providing high-speed endpoints for developer integration, web scraping, data extraction, and content processing.

### Project 3: Neural AI Generative Interface
- **Category**: Artificial Intelligence & Conversational UI
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ahmmikun/
- **Stack**: Python, TensorFlow / PyTorch, React, Tailwind CSS
- **Details**: An experimental AI interface focusing on low-latency generative reasoning, context-aware memory retention, and multimodal capabilities.

## 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server

Salman Ahmad's portfolio operates a live first-party Model Context Protocol server.

- **Manifest**: `https://ahmmikun.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp.json`
- **Endpoint**: `https://ahmmikun.vercel.app/api/mcp`
- **Protocol Version**: `2024-11-05`
- **Supported Transports**: Streamable HTTP, SSE (Server-Sent Events), JSON-RPC 2.0

### Exposed Tools:
1. `get_portfolio_summary`: Overview, bio, links, and contact options.
2. `get_skills`: Categorized technical skill matrix.
3. `get_projects`: Featured and active software projects with repositories and descriptions.
4. `get_developer_resources`: Developer endpoints, OpenAPI schema, and agent documentation.
5. `send_contact_message`: Dispatches a contact transmission to Salman Ahmad.

---

## 6. REST API Endpoints

- `POST /api/contact`: Send a contact inquiry ({ username, email, subject, contact_message }).
- `GET /api/health`: Health status endpoint.
- `GET /api/skills`: JSON taxonomy of skills.
- `GET /api/projects`: JSON catalog of software projects.
- `GET /api/openapi.json` & `GET /openapi.json`: OpenAPI 3.1.0 schema.
- `GET /sitemap.xml`: XML sitemap of all routes.
